title: If only
goal: Daydream, give advice with "if I were you", talk about regrets and wishes, and discuss your plans and dreams for life.
intro:
Friends don't only talk about what happened — they talk about what *could* happen and what *should* have: 'if I won the lottery…', 'if I were you I'd take it', 'if only I'd known!', 'I'm thinking of quitting'. This unit gives you the whole system of **imagined 'if'** in Odia, which you met briefly in unit 19: an 'if' half in **-ଇଥିଲେ** and a 'would' half in **-ନ୍ତି / -ନ୍ତା** (would) or **-ଇଥାନ୍ତି / -ଇଥାନ୍ତା** (would have).

You'll also learn how Odia says 'I wish' — it has no single verb for it, but uses 'it would be good if…' (**…ଥିଲେ ଭଲ ହୁଅନ୍ତା**) — and how people talk about life plans: a government job or Bengaluru, settling down, a little café in Puri one day.

vocab.note: ଲଟେରି ଜିତିବା = to win the lottery.
କୋଟିଏ = one crore. Big money in India is counted in ଲକ୍ଷ (lakh, 100,000) and କୋଟି.
ନିଜର ଘର = a house of one's own; ମୋ ନିଜର = my very own.
ସାରା ଦୁନିଆ = the whole world. More formal: ବିଶ୍ୱ.
With the 'would' form: ବରଂ ମୁଁ ଘରେ ରହନ୍ତି 'I'd rather stay home'.
Takes the dative: ମୋତେ ଜଣା ନାହିଁ 'I don't know', ମୋତେ ଜଣା ନଥିଲା 'I didn't know'. Feels more casual than ମୁଁ ଜାଣେ ନାହିଁ.
ଭାଗ୍ୟ ଭଲ = lucky; ଭାଗ୍ୟ ଖରାପ = unlucky.
ମୁଁ ପସ୍ତାଉଛି = I regret it; ପରେ ପସ୍ତାଇବ = you'll regret it later. Spoken ପସ୍ତେଇବା.

vocab.note: ସରକାରୀ ଚାକିରି = a government job — the dream of many Odia parents.
ଛୋଟବେଳ = childhood; ଛୋଟବେଳର ସାଙ୍ଗ = a childhood friend.
Everyday speech: ଗୋଟେ କଥା 'one thing', ଗୋଟେ ମିନିଟ୍ 'one minute'. Write ଗୋଟିଏ in formal texts.

grammar.title: If I had…, I would…: imagined conditions in full
grammar.body:
Unit 19 introduced the 'would' forms. Here is the whole system — what you need for daydreams ('if I won the lottery…'), advice ('if I were you…') and regrets ('if I'd known…').

**The 'if' half.** For anything imagined or contrary to fact, put the verb in **-ଇଥିଲେ**: ମୁଁ ଜାଣି**ଥିଲେ** 'if I knew / if I had known', ସେ ଆସି**ଥିଲେ** 'if she came / had come', ମୁଁ ଧନୀ ହୋଇ**ଥିଲେ** 'if I were rich'. With ଅଛି 'have / there is' it's just **ଥିଲେ**: ଟଙ୍କା ଥିଲେ 'if I had money'. It never changes for person. Negative: **ନ** in front — ନ ଜାଣିଥିଲେ, **ନଥିଲେ**.

**The 'would' half tells you the time:**
would (now, in general): ମୁଁ ଯାଆନ୍ତି · ତୁ / ଆମେ ଯାଆନ୍ତୁ · ତୁମେ ଯାଆନ୍ତ · ସେ ଯାଆନ୍ତା · ଆପଣ / ସେମାନେ ଯାଆନ୍ତେ
would have (past): ମୁଁ ଯାଇଥାନ୍ତି · ତୁ / ଆମେ ଯାଇଥାନ୍ତୁ · ତୁମେ ଯାଇଥାନ୍ତ · ସେ ଯାଇଥାନ୍ତା · ଆପଣ ଯାଇଥାନ୍ତେ
So ଟଙ୍କା ଥିଲେ ମୁଁ ଘର **କିଣନ୍ତି** 'if I had money I'd buy a house' — but ଟଙ୍କା ଥିଲେ ମୁଁ ସେ ଘର **କିଣିଥାନ୍ତି** 'if I'd had the money I'd have bought that house'. ହେବା gives **ହୁଅନ୍ତା** 'it would be' and **ହୋଇଥାନ୍ତା** 'it would have been'; ଦେବା / ନେବା give ଦିଅନ୍ତି, ନିଅନ୍ତି.

**Wouldn't**: ନାହିଁ after the 'would' form — ମୁଁ ଯାଆନ୍ତି **ନାହିଁ**. **Wouldn't have**: ନ inside, before ଥାନ୍ତ- — ମୁଁ ଯାଇ**ନ**ଥାନ୍ତି, ହୋଇ**ନ**ଥାନ୍ତା.

**If I were you**: ମୁଁ ତୁମ ଜାଗାରେ ଥିଲେ … (lit. 'if I were in your place'), or just ମୁଁ ହୋଇଥିଲେ 'if it were me'.

**Real or imagined?** The plain **-ଲେ** form (unit 19) is for real possibilities: ଚାନ୍ସ ମିଳିଲେ ମୁଁ **ଯିବି** 'if I get the chance, I'll go'. Switch to **-ଇଥିଲେ + would** when you're daydreaming or it's too late: ଚାନ୍ସ ମିଳିଥିଲେ ମୁଁ **ଯାଆନ୍ତି / ଯାଇଥାନ୍ତି**.

The trap: ମୁଁ-forms like **ଯାଆନ୍ତି, କରନ୍ତି** look exactly like the respectful present (ଆପଣ କରନ୍ତି 'you do'), and ତୁ/ଆମେ-forms like **କରନ୍ତୁ** look like 'please do'. The subject and the -ଥିଲେ clause tell you which is meant.

grammar.title: I wish… and if only…: wishes and regrets
grammar.body:
Odia has no single verb for 'wish'. It uses the imagined conditional from the first section, in a few fixed frames.

**A wish about now or the future** — '…would be good': **-ଇଥିଲେ / ଥିଲେ ଭଲ ହୁଅନ୍ତା** — ମୋ ପାଖରେ ନିଜର ଗାଡ଼ି ଥିଲେ ଭଲ ହୁଅନ୍ତା 'I wish I had my own car' (lit. if I had my own car it would be good). As an exclamation: **କେତେ ଭଲ ହୁଅନ୍ତା!** 'how nice that would be!'. The 'would' form on its own can also sigh for something: ଆହା, ଗୋଟେ ଗରମ ଚା **ମିଳନ୍ତା**! 'ah, if only I could get a hot tea!'

**A regret about the past** — 'I wish I had / hadn't': **-ଇଥିଲେ ଭଲ ହୋଇଥାନ୍ତା** — ମୁଁ ଆଉ ଟିକେ ପଢ଼ିଥିଲେ ଭଲ ହୋଇଥାନ୍ତା 'I wish I'd studied a bit more'; with **ନ**: ସେ କଥା ନ କହିଥିଲେ ଭଲ ହୋଇଥାନ୍ତା 'I wish I hadn't said that'. Or simply the 'would have' form with **ଇସ୍**: ଇସ୍, ମୁଁ ବି ଯାଇଥାନ୍ତି! 'oh, I wish I'd gone too!'

**Gentle blame** — 'you could have…': the 'would have' form + **ତ**: ଆଗରୁ **କହିଥାନ୍ତ ତ!** 'you could have told me before!', **ଅନ୍ତତଃ** ଫୋନ ତ **କରିଥାନ୍ତ!** 'you could at least have called!'

**Regret itself**: **ପସ୍ତାଇବା** — ପରେ ପସ୍ତାଇବ 'you'll regret it', ମୁଁ ପସ୍ତାଉନି 'I don't regret it'. The standard excuse: **ମୋତେ ଜଣା ନଥିଲା** 'I didn't know'. And the standard comfort: **ଯାହା ହୁଏ, ଭଲ ପାଇଁ ହୁଏ** 'everything happens for the best'.

The trap: ଚାହେଁ 'want' is for real wants — ମୁଁ ଚାହେଁ ତୁମେ ଆସ 'I want you to come'. For something contrary to fact ('I wish I *had* a car', 'I wish I *hadn't* gone'), don't use ଚାହେଁ; use the '…ଥିଲେ ଭଲ ହୁଅନ୍ତା / ହୋଇଥାନ୍ତା' frame.

grammar.title: Life plans: thinking of…, wanted to…, one day
grammar.body:
A few patterns carry most talk about plans and dreams:

**I'm thinking of …ing**: the -ବା form + **କଥା ଭାବୁଛି** (lit. 'I'm thinking the matter of doing'): ମୁଁ ଚାକିରି ଛାଡ଼ିବା କଥା ଭାବୁଛି 'I'm thinking of quitting my job'. The -ବା form doesn't change; only ଭାବୁଛି changes for the person: ବାପା … ଭାବୁଛନ୍ତି.

**I wanted to (back then)**: -ବାକୁ + **ଚାହୁଁଥିଲି** (past continuous of ଚାହିଁବା): ଛୋଟବେଳେ ମୁଁ ପାଇଲଟ୍ ହେବାକୁ ଚାହୁଁଥିଲି. 'Used to' is the same -ଉଥିଲି form: ଛୋଟବେଳେ ଆମେ ସାରା ଦିନ ଖେଳୁଥିଲୁ.

**Someone wants you to…**: ଚାହାନ୍ତି + a clause with the plain present: ବୋଉ ଚାହାନ୍ତି ମୁଁ ସରକାରୀ ଚାକିରି କରେ 'Mum wants me to do a government job'.

**If I get the chance** — a real possibility, so the plain -ଲେ + future: ଚାନ୍ସ **ମିଳିଲେ** ମୁଁ **ଯିବି**. Compare the daydream ଚାନ୍ସ ମିଳିଥିଲେ ମୁଁ ଯାଆନ୍ତି.

**Some day**: ଦିନେ 'one day', **ଦିନେ ନା ଦିନେ** 'sooner or later'.

If I get the chance, I'll go to Japan.

culture:
Life-plan talk among young Odias often circles the same big question: stay or go. Hundreds of thousands of young people from Odisha work in Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Pune and the Gulf, and many dream of coming back — so 'ଗାଁକୁ / ଘରକୁ ଫେରିବି' is a common line. At home, parents often hope for a **ସରକାରୀ ଚାକିରି** (government job): secure, respected, near home. Bhubaneswar has whole neighbourhoods of coaching centres for the OSSC, OPSC and railway exams, and 'he cleared the exam' is big family news.

When people talk about regrets, they tend to soften them with a touch of fatalism: **ଯାହା ହୁଏ, ଭଲ ପାଇଁ ହୁଏ** 'everything happens for the best', **ଭାଗ୍ୟରେ ଥିଲେ ହେବ** 'if it's in your fate, it'll happen', or, very Odia, **ସବୁ ଜଗନ୍ନାଥଙ୍କ ଇଚ୍ଛା** 'it's all Jagannath's will'. Saying a regret too bluntly can sound like blaming others, so people often wrap it in a laugh or a sigh — **ଇସ୍!** for 'what a shame', **ଆହା!** for longing.

Between close friends, advice is direct and uses **ତୁ**: ମୁଁ ତୋ ଜାଗାରେ ଥିଲେ… 'if I were you…'. With older people or at work, the same advice goes up to **ଆପଣ** and is phrased as a suggestion: ମୋ ମତରେ… 'in my opinion…'.

tip.title: If I had…, I would…
tip.body:
- 'If' half: **-ଇଥିଲେ** (ଅଛି → **ଥିଲେ**): ମୁଁ ଧନୀ ହୋଇ**ଥିଲେ**, ଟଙ୍କା **ଥିଲେ**.
- 'Would' half: ମୁଁ କିଣ**ନ୍ତି** · ତୁମେ କିଣ**ନ୍ତ** · ସେ କିଣ**ନ୍ତା** · ଆପଣ କିଣ**ନ୍ତେ**.
- 'It would be': **ହୁଅନ୍ତା**.
- Real possibility? Use plain -ଲେ + future instead.

sentences.native: ମୁଁ ଧନୀ ହୋଇଥିଲେ ଚାକିରି ଛାଡ଼ିଦିଅନ୍ତି।
sentences.roman: muṃ dhôni hoithile chakiri chhaṛidiônti.

sentences.native: କୋଟିଏ ଟଙ୍କା ଥିଲେ ମୁଁ ସାରା ଦୁନିଆ ବୁଲନ୍ତି।
sentences.roman: koṭie ṭôṅka thile muṃ sara dunia bulônti.

sentences.native: ତୁମେ ଲଟେରି ଜିତିଥିଲେ ପ୍ରଥମେ କ'ଣ କିଣନ୍ତ?
sentences.roman: tume lôṭeri jitithile prôthôme kôṇô kiṇôntô?

sentences.native: ମୋ ପାଖରେ ଜମି ଥିଲେ ମୁଁ ଗୋଟିଏ ଘର କରନ୍ତି।
sentences.roman: mo pakhôre jômi thile muṃ goṭie ghôrô kôrônti.

sentences.native: ସେ ଧନୀ ହୋଇଥିଲେ ଗରିବ ପିଲାଙ୍କୁ ସାହାଯ୍ୟ କରନ୍ତା।
sentences.roman: se dhôni hoithile gôribô pilaṅku sahajjyô kôrônta.
sentences.en: If he were rich, he'd help poor kids.

sentences.native: ଆମ ନିଜର ଘର ଥିଲେ ଭଡ଼ା ଦେବାକୁ ପଡ଼ନ୍ତା ନାହିଁ।
sentences.roman: amô nijôrô ghôrô thile bhôṛa debaku pôṛônta nahiṃ.
sentences.en: If we had our own house, we wouldn't have to pay rent.

sentences.native: ଏବେ ପୁରୀରେ ଥିଲେ କେତେ ଭଲ ହୁଅନ୍ତା!
sentences.roman: ebe Purire thile kete bhôlô huônta!
sentences.en: How nice it would be to be in Puri right now!

sentences.native: ତୁମେ କେବେ ଲଟେରି ଟିକଟ କିଣିଛ କି?

sentences.native: ଟଙ୍କା ସବୁ କିଛି ନୁହେଁ, ଗରିବ ଲୋକ ବି ଖୁସିରେ ରହନ୍ତି।

sentences.en: Money isn't everything — poor people live happily too.

lessons.title: Giving advice: if I were you…

tip.title: If I were you…
tip.body:
- **ମୁଁ ତୁମ ଜାଗାରେ ଥିଲେ** … (ତୁ-friend: ମୁଁ **ତୋ** ଜାଗାରେ ଥିଲେ) or **ମୁଁ ହୋଇଥିଲେ** 'if it were me'.
- Then the ମୁଁ 'would' form: ମୁଁ **ନିଅନ୍ତି** 'I'd take it'.
- 'Wouldn't': add **ନାହିଁ** — ମୁଁ ଯାଆନ୍ତି **ନାହିଁ**.
- **ବରଂ** 'rather': ବରଂ ମୁଁ ଘରେ ରହନ୍ତି.

new: ମୁଁ ତୁମ ଜାଗାରେ ଥିଲେ ଯାଆନ୍ତି ନାହିଁ।

sentences.native: ମୁଁ ତୁମ ଜାଗାରେ ଥିଲେ ସେ ଚାକିରି ନିଅନ୍ତି।
sentences.roman: muṃ tumô jagare thile se chakiri niônti.
sentences.en: If I were you, I'd take that job.

sentences.native: ମୁଁ ହୋଇଥିଲେ ଏତେ ଦାମୀ ଫୋନ କିଣନ୍ତି ନାହିଁ।
sentences.roman: muṃ hoithile ete dami phonô kiṇônti nahiṃ.
sentences.en: If it were me, I wouldn't buy such an expensive phone.

sentences.native: ଏତେ ଭିଡ଼ରେ ମୁଁ ଯାଆନ୍ତି ନାହିଁ, ବରଂ ଘରେ ଟିଭି ଦେଖନ୍ତି।
sentences.roman: ete bhiṛôre muṃ jaônti nahiṃ, bôrôṅ ghôre ṭibhi dekhônti.
sentences.en: I wouldn't go in this crowd — I'd rather watch TV at home.

sentences.native: ତୁମେ ମୋ ଜାଗାରେ ଥିଲେ କ'ଣ ନିଷ୍ପତ୍ତି ନିଅନ୍ତ?
sentences.roman: tume mo jagare thile kôṇô nispôtti niôntô?
sentences.en: What would you decide in my place?

sentences.native: ଆପଣ ମୋ ଜାଗାରେ ଥିଲେ ଏହି ଫ୍ଲାଟ୍ ନିଅନ୍ତେ କି?
sentences.roman: apôṇô mo jagare thile ehi phlaṭ niônte ki?
sentences.en: Would you take this flat if you were me?

sentences.native: ମୁଁ ତୁମ ଜାଗାରେ ଥିଲେ ତାକୁ ସତ କହିଦିଅନ୍ତି।
sentences.roman: muṃ tumô jagare thile taku sôtô kôhidiônti.
sentences.en: If I were you, I'd tell her the truth.

sentences.native: ଭାବିଚିନ୍ତି ନିଷ୍ପତ୍ତି ନିଅ, ସମୟ ଅଛି।
sentences.roman: bhabichinti nispôtti niô, sômôyô ôchhi.
sentences.en: Think it through before you decide — there's time.

sentences.native: ସେ କିଛି ନ ଭାବି ନିଷ୍ପତ୍ତି ନେଲା।
sentences.roman: se kichhi nô bhabi nispôtti nela.
sentences.en: He decided without thinking at all.

tip.title: Would have: -ଇଥାନ୍ତି
tip.body:
- Past imagined result: add **-ଇଥାନ୍ତ-**: ମୁଁ ଆସି**ଥାନ୍ତି** · ତୁମେ କହି**ଥାନ୍ତ** · ସେ ହୋଇ**ଥାନ୍ତା** · ଆମେ ଜିତି**ଥାନ୍ତୁ**.
- 'Wouldn't have': **ନ** before ଥାନ୍ତ- — ହୋଇ**ନ**ଥାନ୍ତା.
- 'You could at least have…': **ଅନ୍ତତଃ** … **-ଇଥାନ୍ତ!**

sentences.native: ମୋତେ ଜଣା ଥିଲେ ମୁଁ ଷ୍ଟେସନକୁ ଆସିଥାନ୍ତି।
sentences.roman: mote jôṇa thile muṃ sṭesônôku asithanti.
sentences.en: If I'd known, I'd have come to the station.

sentences.native: ତୁମେ ଆଗରୁ କହିଥିଲେ ମୁଁ ଛୁଟି ନେଇଥାନ୍ତି।
sentences.roman: tume agôru kôhithile muṃ chhuṭi neithanti.
sentences.en: If you'd told me earlier, I'd have taken leave.

sentences.native: ଟ୍ରାଫିକ୍ ନଥିଲେ ଆମେ ସମୟରେ ପହଞ୍ଚିଥାନ୍ତୁ।
sentences.roman: ṭraphik nôthile ame sômôyôre pôhôñchithantu.
sentences.en: If there hadn't been traffic, we'd have got there on time.

sentences.native: ଅନ୍ତତଃ ମୋତେ କହିଥାନ୍ତ!
sentences.roman: ôntôtô mote kôhithantô!
sentences.en: You could at least have told me!

sentences.native: ମୋତେ ଜଣା ନଥିଲା ଯେ ଆଜି ଦୋକାନ ବନ୍ଦ।
sentences.roman: mote jôṇa nôthila je aji dokanô bôndô.
sentences.en: I didn't know the shop was closed today.

sentences.native: ଭାଗ୍ୟ ଭଲ ଥିଲେ ଆମେ ମ୍ୟାଚ୍ ଜିତିଥାନ୍ତୁ।
sentences.roman: bhaggyô bhôlô thile ame myach jitithantu.
sentences.en: With a bit of luck we'd have won the match.

sentences.native: ସେ ଟିକେ ସାବଧାନ ହୋଇଥିଲେ ଦୁର୍ଘଟଣା ହୋଇନଥାନ୍ତା।
sentences.roman: se ṭike sabôdhanô hoithile durghôṭôṇa hoinôthanta.
sentences.en: If he'd been a bit careful, the accident wouldn't have happened.

sentences.native: ମୋ ଭାଗ୍ୟ ଖରାପ, ବସ୍ ଏବେ ଛାଡ଼ିଲା।
sentences.roman: mo bhaggyô khôrapô, bôs ebe chhaṛila.
sentences.en: Just my luck — the bus has just left.

sentences.native: ମୁଁ ଜାଣିଥିଲେ ତୁମ ପାଇଁ ଖାଇବା ରଖିଥାନ୍ତି।
sentences.roman: muṃ jaṇithile tumô paiṃ khaiba rôkhithanti.
sentences.en: If I'd known, I'd have saved you some food.

tip.title: I wish = it would be good if…
tip.body:
- Wish (now): **…ଥିଲେ ଭଲ ହୁଅନ୍ତା** 'I wish I had / were…'.
- Regret (past): **…-ଇଥିଲେ ଭଲ ହୋଇଥାନ୍ତା** 'I wish I had…'; **ନ** -ଇଥିଲେ 'I wish I hadn't'.
- With a sigh: **ଇସ୍**, ମୁଁ ବି ଯାଇଥାନ୍ତି! · **ଆହା**, ଚା ମିଳନ୍ତା!
- 'To regret': **ପସ୍ତାଇବା**. Don't use ଚାହେଁ for these.

sentences.native: ମୋ ଘର ଅଫିସ୍ ପାଖରେ ଥିଲେ ଭଲ ହୁଅନ୍ତା।
sentences.roman: mo ghôrô ôphis pakhôre thile bhôlô huônta.
sentences.en: I wish I lived near the office.

sentences.native: ମୁଁ ସ୍କୁଲରେ ଓଡ଼ିଆ ଶିଖିଥିଲେ ଭଲ ହୋଇଥାନ୍ତା।
sentences.roman: muṃ skulôre Oṛia sikhithile bhôlô hoithanta.
sentences.en: I wish I'd learned Odia at school.

sentences.native: ଏତେ ନ ଖାଇଥିଲେ ଭଲ ହୋଇଥାନ୍ତା, ପେଟ ବିନ୍ଧୁଛି।
sentences.roman: ete nô khaithile bhôlô hoithanta, peṭô bindhuchhi.
sentences.en: I wish I hadn't eaten so much — my stomach hurts.

sentences.native: ଇସ୍, ମୁଁ ବି ତୁମ ସହ ପୁରୀ ଯାଇଥାନ୍ତି!
sentences.roman: is, muṃ bi tumô sôhô Puri jaithanti!
sentences.en: Oh, I wish I'd gone to Puri with you!

sentences.native: ଆହା, ଏବେ ଗୋଟିଏ ଗରମ ଚା ମିଳନ୍ତା!
sentences.roman: aha, ebe goṭie gôrômô cha miḷônta!
sentences.en: Ahh, if only I could get a hot tea right now!

sentences.native: ସେ ଚାକିରି ଛାଡ଼ିଲେ ପରେ ପସ୍ତାଇବ।
sentences.roman: se chakiri chhaṛile pôre pôstaibô.
sentences.en: If you leave that job, you'll regret it later.

sentences.native: ମୁଁ ଗାଁ ଛାଡ଼ି ଆସିଲି, କିନ୍ତୁ ପସ୍ତାଉନି।
sentences.roman: muṃ gaṃ chhaṛi asili, kintu pôstauni.
sentences.en: I left the village, but I don't regret it.

sentences.native: ଚିନ୍ତା କର ନାହିଁ, ଯାହା ହୁଏ ଭଲ ପାଇଁ ହୁଏ।
sentences.roman: chinta kôrô nahiṃ, jaha hue bhôlô paiṃ hue.
sentences.en: Don't worry — everything happens for the best.

sentences.native: ଇସ୍, ବର୍ଷା ଆସିଗଲା, ଲୁଗା ଓଦା ହୋଇଗଲା।
sentences.roman: is, bôrsa asigôla, luga oda hoigôla.
sentences.en: Oh no, it's started raining — the washing's got wet.

tip.title: Thinking of…, if I get the chance…
tip.body:
- 'Thinking of doing': **-ବା କଥା ଭାବୁଛି** — ଚାକିରି ଛାଡ଼ି**ବା** କଥା ଭାବୁଛି.
- 'If I get the chance' is real: **ଚାନ୍ସ ମିଳିଲେ** + future (ଯିବି).
- Someone wants you to: ବୋଉ **ଚାହାନ୍ତି** ମୁଁ … କରେ.
- **ଦିନେ ନା ଦିନେ** 'sooner or later'.

sentences.native: ମୁଁ ଭୁବନେଶ୍ୱରରେ ନିଜର ଫ୍ଲାଟ୍ କିଣିବା କଥା ଭାବୁଛି।
sentences.roman: muṃ Bhubôneswôrôre nijôrô phlaṭ kiṇiba kôtha bhabuchhi.
sentences.en: I'm thinking of buying my own flat in Bhubaneswar.

sentences.native: ମୋ ଜୀବନର ଲକ୍ଷ୍ୟ କ'ଣ, ମୁଁ ଏବେ ବି ଜାଣିନି।
sentences.roman: mo jibônôrô lôkhyô kôṇô, muṃ ebe bi jaṇini.
sentences.en: I still don't know what my goal in life is.

sentences.native: ବୋଉ ଚାହାନ୍ତି ମୁଁ ସରକାରୀ ଚାକିରି କରେ।
sentences.roman: bou chahanti muṃ sôrôkari chakiri kôre.
sentences.en: Mum wants me to get a government job.

sentences.native: ଚାନ୍ସ ମିଳିଲେ ମୁଁ ବିଦେଶରେ ପଢ଼ିବାକୁ ଯିବି।
sentences.roman: chans miḷile muṃ bidesôre pôṛhibaku jibi.
sentences.en: If I get the chance, I'll go and study abroad.

sentences.native: ଅବସର ପରେ ବାପା ଗାଁକୁ ଫେରିବା କଥା ଭାବୁଛନ୍ତି।
sentences.roman: ôbôsôrô pôre bapa gaṃku pheriba kôtha bhabuchhônti.
sentences.en: Dad's thinking of moving back to the village after he retires.

sentences.native: ତୁମେ ସତରେ ଚାକିରି ଛାଡ଼ିବା କଥା ଭାବୁଛ?
sentences.roman: tume sôtôre chakiri chhaṛiba kôtha bhabuchhô?
sentences.en: Are you really thinking of quitting your job?

sentences.native: ସେ ଜୀବନରେ ବହୁତ ସଫଳ ହେଲେ।
sentences.roman: se jibônôre bôhutô sôphôḷô hele.
sentences.en: She's done really well in life.

sentences.native: ଦିନେ ନା ଦିନେ ମୁଁ ନିଜର ବ୍ୟବସାୟ ଆରମ୍ଭ କରିବି।
sentences.roman: dine na dine muṃ nijôrô byôbôsayô arômbhô kôribi.
sentences.en: Sooner or later I'll start my own business.

sentences.native: ସରକାରୀ ଚାକିରି ପାଇବା ସହଜ ନୁହେଁ।
sentences.roman: sôrôkari chakiri paiba sôhôjô nuheṃ.
sentences.en: Getting a government job isn't easy.

tip.title: Back then: wanted to, used to
tip.body:
- 'I wanted to (be)': **-ବାକୁ ଚାହୁଁଥିଲି** — ପାଇଲଟ୍ ହେବାକୁ ଚାହୁଁଥିଲି.
- 'Used to': **-ଉଥିଲି** — ଯାଉଥିଲି, ଖେଳୁଥିଲୁ.
- **ଛୋଟବେଳେ** 'as a kid'.
- In speech ଗୋଟିଏ is often **ଗୋଟେ**: ଗୋଟେ କଥା 'one thing'.

sentences.native: ଛୋଟବେଳେ ତୁମେ କ'ଣ ହେବାକୁ ଚାହୁଁଥିଲ?
sentences.roman: chhoṭôbeḷe tume kôṇô hebaku chahuṃthilô?
sentences.en: What did you want to be when you were little?

sentences.native: ମୁଁ ଡାକ୍ତର ହେବାକୁ ଚାହୁଁଥିଲି, କିନ୍ତୁ ଇଞ୍ଜିନିୟର ହେଲି।
sentences.roman: muṃ ḍaktôrô hebaku chahuṃthili, kintu iñjiniyôrô heli.
sentences.en: I wanted to be a doctor, but I became an engineer.

sentences.native: ଛୋଟବେଳେ ମୁଁ ପ୍ରତି ରବିବାର ଜେଜେମାଙ୍କ ଘରକୁ ଯାଉଥିଲି।
sentences.roman: chhoṭôbeḷe muṃ prôti rôbibarô jejemaṅkô ghôrôku jauthili.
sentences.en: As a kid I used to go to Grandma's every Sunday.

sentences.native: ପାଇଲଟ୍ ହେବା ମୋର ଛୋଟବେଳର ସ୍ୱପ୍ନ ଥିଲା।
sentences.roman: pailôṭ heba morô chhoṭôbeḷôrô swôpnô thila.
sentences.en: Being a pilot was my childhood dream.

sentences.native: ଛୋଟବେଳେ ଆମେ ସାରା ଦିନ ବାହାରେ ଖେଳୁଥିଲୁ।
sentences.roman: chhoṭôbeḷe ame sara dinô bahare kheḷuthilu.
sentences.en: As kids we used to play outside all day.

sentences.native: ମୋ ଭାଇ ଗୋଟେ ନୂଆ ଚାକିରି ପାଇଛି।
sentences.roman: mo bhai goṭe nua chakiri paichhi.
sentences.en: My brother's got a new job.

sentences.native: ମୁଁ ଗୋଟେ କଥା କହିବି, ରାଗିବ ନାହିଁ।
sentences.roman: muṃ goṭe kôtha kôhibi, ragibô nahiṃ.
sentences.en: I'm going to tell you something — don't get angry.

sentences.native: ତୁମର ସବୁଠାରୁ ବଡ଼ ସ୍ୱପ୍ନ କ'ଣ?
sentences.roman: tumôrô sôbuṭharu bôṛô swôpnô kôṇô?
sentences.en: What's your biggest dream?
